reviews.text: They were so nice. The dogs seemed perfectly fine after coming home. They didn’t show any signs of stress or behave any differently than usual.

At our first meeting with Ken & Yvonne, I can feel their genuine love for animals and totally felt at ease leaving our puppy Ellie for daycare and boarding. She came back a bit more confident and calmer after joining the pack for daily walks and playtime. At the day of pickup, Ellie gave them the warmest head hugs which spoke a thousand words. Safe to say she had the best time and will definitely be back for more adventures.
The only place we trust with our dog. She always comes back well exercised and better behaved.

Kenn and Yvonne care for our dog as if she were their own. We feel very confident and happy leaving our now six-year-old with them when we are out of town. For the last four years, Ruby has been excited to stay with them in their home.

Booking and communication are always easy and efficient.

My family loves the daily pictures posted on Facebook, and we always marvel at how they get the dogs to sit and smile!

I highly recommend Marpole Dog Walking and Boarding, as well as Kenn and Yvonne.
Ken and Yvonne are wonderful. They take great care of your dogs and often go above and beyond. Would recommend to anyone

Ken & Yvonne are such amazing people. How they care for the furry friends reflect how they are as people ..... patient, compassionate, creative and funny. Our Bailey really thrived in her first couple of years of life in K&Y's care.

Ken and Yvonne are INCREDIBLE! Nina has been staying with them for 3 years now. I feel so happy to have found such an amazing place for her to “vacation” while I am away. She adores them and always comes back the most happy and very well looked after. It gives me peace of mind knowing she is having a blast and is safe. I would recommend Ken and Yvonne to anyone who wants the very best for their fur baby while they are away. Thank you both soooo much.

My dog, Parker, loves Ken and Yvonne and is always super eager to see them :) it’s clear that they take such good care of the dogs and  I love how it’s a different adventure everytime Parker comes over to doggy daycare! Ken and Yvonne are also super generous people and sometimes drop off/pick up my dog  which I appreciate a ton since I don’t always have a car available. Im super glad I found this place and Parker can’t wait until his next daycare reservation! Thank you guys
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating, Babak! We truly appreciate your support.

We recently went with Marpole Dog Walking & Boarding Service for the first time and had a lovely and seamless experience. Ken and Yvonne were kind and lovely people who truly cared for our dog. They provided consistent updates and we could see that our dog was enjoying the outdoors and spending time with other dogs. We will be bringing our dog back the next time we require boarding service, and highly recommend Ken and Yvonne to all.
Very nice and kind they clean my puppy too.Good job so thankfully

I made arrangements while I was in the US to drop off Noodle on a Friday. However, due to mishaps on my accomodations, they immediately took her in as soon as I landed Vancouver. It was a last minute request and they are very nice folks. I will bring my dog to them again. Ken and Yvonne are really nice. When I was picking up Noodle, they felt they were being separated from their grandchild, Ken’s arm on Yvonne’s shoulder as they bid us goodbye. Noodle would climb up to Ken’s lap as soon as he sat on the couch. Noodle became more affectionate when we returned to the US. Yvonne paid attention to the needs of the other dogs as well. Fed 3x a day plus treats and lots of hugs. They are really wonderful! I will bring Noodle back to them on my next trip.
